summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with hands-on experience across the machine learning lifecycle in Python: dataset curation, computer vision model training, and TensorRT-optimized production deployment. Delivered a 5.2x inference speedup on a real-time YOLO vision pipeline and shipped it as a systemd-managed production service with auto-restart and non-root isolation. Trained and evaluated CV models spanning U-Net segmentation, YOLO detection, and monocular depth estimation across Dice, IoU, and mAP metrics.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86 for high-resolution image generation.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for real-time visual servoing in a vision-guided pick-and-place system.
Deployed the Jetson-side vision service as a systemd service with auto-restart, non-root isolation, and static IP networking for reliable production operation.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory, achieving 49.2ms vs 77.5ms CPU baseline — a 1.5–2× speedup with identical classification accuracy.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
